criteria.config_echo: Address repeats the attempted host:port taken from validated configuration, so an ephemeral request shows port 0. The value never varies by platform and never embeds errno text, native messages, or resolver specifics.
criteria.native_detail: Address preserves the native diagnostic detail such as the errno code plus Bun message wording. That keeps bind failures debuggable by operators while accepting platform-dependent strings that partly duplicate the attempted address.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle what address should carry, or neither candidate content upholds the contracts.

bind_address.instructions: Select the bind_failed address payload: a stable echo of the configured host:port attempt, or the platform-native failure detail from Bun. Balance determinism and sanitization against debuggability from common and topics.bind_address.

criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot distinguish the validation splits, or neither split upholds the contracts.
criteria.split_authority: make_server_config checks only the numbers the adapter consumes (body_limit and shutdown_ms ranges). It accepts every type-correct port and host; Bun RangeError, resolver throws, and EADDRINUSE then emerge as bind_failed from server_start. Address authority lives in exactly one place with no mirrored rules.
criteria.static_first: make_server_config checks port 0-65535, a host that is non-empty, NUL-free, and at most 253 chars, plus the body_limit and shutdown_ms ranges, emitting invalid_server_config whose reason names the field. server_start then reports only resolution and availability as bind_failed. Pure configuration mistakes reproduce without binding.

config_split.instructions: Allocate validation duty between make_server_config and the Bun bind: everything checkable without binding at config time leaving only bind-time facts to the server start, versus numbers at config time with every address verdict deferred to Bun. Decide from common plus topics.config_split.

criteria.dispatch_bounded: The server lease spans snapshot, dispatch, and conversion, releasing before the fetch task hands back its Response. Native stop(false) owns socket completion. Every request performs exactly one acquisition and one release, both within the fetch task.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle the lease span, or neither span upholds the contracts.
criteria.socket_bounded: The lease persists until the response body has been completely transmitted through a wrapped body stream. This layers adapter gating over the native drain and pushes the release outside the fetch task into streaming machinery.

lease_scope.instructions: Settle how long a request keeps its server lease: Can-side dispatch alone with native socket drain, or through full response-body transmission. Decide from common and topics.lease_scope.

criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle the numeric bounds, or neither pair of bounds upholds the contracts.
criteria.sibling_mirror: body_limit spans 1-67108864 and shutdown_ms spans 0-2147483647; anything outside raises invalid_server_config identifying the field. Timer arms remain within the exact setTimeout domain and the inbound cap follows the existing sibling precedent.
criteria.unbounded_above: body_limit takes any int >= 1 and shutdown_ms takes any safe int >= 0, while the adapter quietly clamps timer arms at 2147483647. Nothing is rejected for magnitude; enormous values collapse onto a roughly 24.8-day bound.

numeric_bounds.instructions: Settle the body_limit and shutdown_ms domains: align with the sibling cap and the exact timer domain, or take any non-negative size with hidden timer clamping. Decide from common and topics.numeric_bounds.

criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle the phase vocabulary, or neither vocabulary upholds the contracts.
criteria.single_phase: Every shutdown failure reports phase stop, caller-wait expiry included. Matching needs one phase; a caller detects its own timeout from elapsed time instead of the value.
criteria.two_phase: A bounded stop wait that lapses while closing continues reports phase deadline; a throwing native stop reports phase stop; server_wait forwards the close completion phase. Callers distinguish still-closing from close-failed.

phase_vocabulary.instructions: Settle whether shutdown_failed phases separate caller-wait expiry from native-stop failure or collapse every shutdown failure into one phase. Decide from common and topics.phase_vocabulary.

criteria.idempotent_settlement: The server registers idempotent. Repeat stops get back the shared settlement completion, ok included after close, so convergence sheds its swallowing. Repeated-stop scripts run silent while staleness goes unreported.
criteria.resource_state: The server registers non-idempotent. Stopping while closing repeats, or stopping a closed handle, yields standard resource_state; the signal path absorbs already-closing. server_wait keeps the observation duty while stop surfaces staleness.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle repeated-stop conduct, or neither conduct upholds the contracts.

repeated_stop.instructions: Settle repeat and stale stop conduct: standard resource_state failures from a non-idempotent server, or the shared settlement completion from an idempotent one. Decide from common and topics.repeated_stop.

criteria.all_open: server_start fits one listener pair per server, lifted at close, so signals close each open server awaited or otherwise. Shutdown is uniform, while default kill behavior changes as soon as anything starts.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle signal ownership, or neither ownership upholds the contracts.
criteria.waited_only: server_wait fits its own SIGINT/SIGTERM pair per call, lifted at settle, and its handler opens the shared close. Servers lacking a waiter retain default process behavior; signals touch awaited servers alone.

signal_scope.instructions: Settle signal reach: awaited servers only through waiter-fitted listeners, or all open servers through start-fitted listeners. Decide from common and topics.signal_scope.

fixed_constraints: Compilation rule: each Can operation becomes its equivalent native JavaScript/Bun operation; adapters appear solely to uphold Can contracts and immutability. There are no external users, so legacy syntax, ABI, layouts, and goldens deserve no compatibility effort; keep the compiler simple wherever semantics survive.

Catalogue authority: make_server_config(host:str, port:int, body_limit:int, shutdown_ms:int) yields server_config, executes genuinely under assertions, and emits invalid_server_config{reason:str}; server_start(config,router) yields server, takes fixtures under assertions, and emits bind_failed{address:str}; server_wait(server) and server_stop(server) yield void, take fixtures, and emit shutdown_failed{phase:str}. server_stop carries no deadline parameter. Numeric ranges appear nowhere in the catalogue.

Ownership mechanics (runtime/owner.ts reused verbatim): registerResource(kind,native,close,{idempotent,scopeManaged,shutdownMilliseconds}); closeResource(value,kind,deadline?) with a deadline that caps only that caller wait as closing proceeds; beginClose drains all live leases before running close a single time; closing a closing or closed non-idempotent resource produces standard resource_state; guardCallback re-enters context-free native dispatch as a tracked task; closing scopes auto-close open members while scopeManaged drops just the failure report; registered shutdownMs starts a drain timer whose cleanup-failure report leaves closing underway, withdrawn once close finishes.

Observed Bun 1.4 conduct: Bun.serve binds synchronously; stop(closeActiveConnections?) gives back void synchronously; stop(false) completes requests already underway and declines fresh connections; localhost is the default hostname; port 0 draws an ephemeral port; ports outside range or off-integer raise RangeError synchronously; hosts that cannot resolve or embed NUL raise synchronously; reusing a bound port raises Error code EADDRINUSE.

Task mandates: every request keeps a server lease across exactly one acquisition and one release; dispatch escapees turn into a sanitized 500 free of native causes, credentials, and domain payloads; signal and explicit stop paths meet in a single close; server_wait never settles just because some other caller stop wait lapsed; stop(true) under live work is outlawed.
I32 already settled: snapshotRequest returns ok or rejected, with 400 marking malformed ingress and 413 marking bodies past the limit.
common.purpose: Advise on Can, an immutable compiled language, from this request evidence alone. Outside research, implementation work, and explanatory answer prose are all out of scope. Whenever candidates stay indistinguishable, the explicit uncertainty option fits.

bind_address.facts: server_start emits nothing besides bind_failed{address:str}. Native throws use platform-shaped wording (EADDRINUSE 'Failed to start server. Is port N in use?', resolver codes, RangeError internals). Sanitization duties in the task address wire responses; bind failures reach the Can caller rather than the client. Operator logging beyond late/cleanup diagnostics does not exist.

config_split.facts: make_server_config validates purely, binds nothing, executes genuinely under assertions, and emits solely invalid_server_config{reason}. server_start does the binding and emits bind_failed{address}. At bind time Bun judges ports (RangeError) and hosts (synchronous resolution throw). Integer ranges, emptiness, NUL bytes, and length caps need no bind to check; resolution and availability do.

lease_scope.facts: Observed: stop(false) finishes a fetch already running (body arrived, Bun pending count drained) yet declines new connections. Adapter leases hold Can-side dispatch completion inside beginClose. Bodies can keep streaming once the fetch handler has returned its Response.

numeric_bounds.facts: Sibling precedent ai-io max_body_bytes runs 1-67108864 defaulting to 8388608. Server configuration offers no defaults because it demands all four inputs. shutdown_ms feeds closeResource caller deadlines plus the registered drain bound, each realized via setTimeout, which wraps past 2^31-1 ms (near 24.8 days) into early firing. body_limit caps inbound buffering in snapshotRequest absent pre-allocation; readers halt at the cap.

phase_vocabulary.facts: server_stop exposes no deadline knob; shutdown_ms inside server_config is the lone configured duration. closeResource takes a caller-only deadline whose lapse reports failure as closing proceeds. Native stop(false) hands back void synchronously. Caller-wait lapse, throwing native stop, and a wait meeting a failed close form separate cases.

repeated_stop.facts: Task: check repeat and stale operations against the resource-state rules. closeResource on closing or closed non-idempotent resources fails standard resource_state. Idempotent closeResource instead hands back the shared settlement completion. Merging signal and explicit-stop paths demands already-closing tolerance (non-idempotent with swallowing) or emerges free (idempotent).

signal_scope.facts: Any SIGINT/SIGTERM listener displaces process-wide default kill conduct. The signal-listening duty belongs to server_wait; server_start owns no signal role. Several servers and several waits on one server may coexist; closing converges singly at beginClose, where surplus closeResource attempts on a closing non-idempotent resource fail standard for the handler to swallow.
